reference.title: MODULE REFERENCE
reference.argon2Pow.name: Argon2 PoW
reference.argon2Pow.effect: Memory-hard proof-of-work (default 64 MB) instead of SHA-256 hashcash — 100–1000× more GPU-expensive.
reference.privacyPass.name: Privacy Pass
reference.privacyPass.effect: Accept anonymous trust tokens from Cloudflare, Apple, and Fastly issuers. Verified browsers skip the ladder silently.
reference.chainedTrust.name: Chained trust
reference.chainedTrust.effect: Cleared captcha = 24h bypass for all weaker tiers. Cleared PoW = 1h. Cookie = 5min.
reference.adaptive.name: Adaptive ladder
reference.adaptive.effect: Anomaly mode bumps bits; high suspicion fast-tracks past cookie; randomized starting level defeats fingerprinting.
reference.variedErrors.name: Varied errors
reference.variedErrors.effect: Rotate 'Origin DNS Error' / 'Gateway Timeout' / etc. instead of 'blocked'. Slows attacker reverse-engineering.
reference.decoyCaptcha.name: Decoy CAPTCHA
reference.decoyCaptcha.effect: Render plausible CAPTCHA to very-suspicious clients (≥0.9 score), reject all answers. Wastes attacker's 2captcha quota.
reference.honeypotFields.name: Honeypot fields
reference.honeypotFields.effect: Inject CSS-hidden form fields; filled = bot = instant deny. Real users never fill (display:none + tabindex=-1).
reference.trustForAuth.name: Trust for auth
reference.trustForAuth.effect: By default /login etc. always re-challenges. Enable if your operators want session-long bypass on cleared captcha.
